summary_en: Gallium is a chemical element with symbol Ga and atomic number 31. Elemental gallium does not occur in free form in nature, but as the gallium(III) compounds that are in trace amounts in zinc ores and in bauxite. Gallium is a soft, silvery metal, and elemental gallium is a brittle solid at low temperatures, and melts at 29.76 °C (85.57 °F) (slightly above room temperature).
summary_ko: Gallium은(는) 후전이 금속 원소로, 교육·연구·산업에 활용되는 기본 소재다. 상온에서는 이며 안전 지침을 따라 다루는 것이 권장된다.
